#include <config.h>

#include "idn2.h"
#include "punycode.h"

int
idn2_decode (const char *label, uint32_t *res, size_t *len)
{
  size_t labellen = strlen (label);
  size_t input_length = labellen;
  const char *input = label;
  size_t output_length = *len;
  uint32_t *output = res;
  int rc;

  if (labellen >= 4 && label[0] == 'x' && label[1] == 'n' && label[2] == '-'
      && label[3] == '-')
    {
      input += 4;
      input_length -= 4;
    }

  rc = _idn2_punycode_decode (input_length, input, &output_length, output);
  if (rc != IDN2_OK)
    return rc;

  *len = output_length;
  return IDN2_OK;
}
